chapter_seo_title: RMJI Chapter 602: Stormwind Mountain Climb & Crying Soul Beast Evolution
chapter_meta_description: Stormwind Mountain’s Yin wind and black ice push Han Li to his physical limits. The Crying Soul Beast evolves. Then footsteps echo in the fog.
og_title: RMJI Ch.602: The Evil Spirit Beast Evolves — And Someone Is Watching
og_description: Stormwind Mountain is more than a wall of ice and death-mist. Han Li’s spirit beast just got stronger. But he is not alone on the mountain.
twitter_title: Mortal Stream Ch.602 — A silver ape, a frozen hell, and a threat in the mist.
twitter_description: Stormwind Mountain: the last climb before the rift opens. Han Li’s Crying Soul Beast takes a bizarre new form. But someone else is climbing, too.

lore_anchors.definition: A Yin-heavy pocket realm accessible from the Heavenly Star Sea through periodic spatial rifts; rich in Yin beasts and haunted by ghostly mists, it is a dangerous but lucrative resource zone for Foundation Establishment and Core Formation cultivators.
A rare treasure that neutralizes wind-based effects within its glow; highly prized in stormy or Yin-wind environments, but it only suppresses force, not other hazards like cold or corrosive mist.
A condensed energy core found in high-tier Yin beasts inside the Netherworld Domain; rare outside such realms, making collection a strategic resource-gathering opportunity.

Pearls that emit a pure azure light capable of neutralizing corrosive Yin miasma; they consume spiritual energy to maintain their barrier, making them a limited-duration survival tool in mist-filled zones.
A rare beast-type spirit spirit with an innate ability to consume Yin energy, ghostly matter, and souls; its deployment is framed as tool-use logistics, not pet-bonding.

cultural_notes_faq.a: It’s a separate pocket-dimension accessible from the Heavenly Star Sea only when spatial rifts open; it’s full of ghostly mist, Yin beasts, and rare ores—a high-risk farming zone for cultivators who can survive its environment.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is Stormwind Mountain so hard to climb?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It has three escalating hazards: a bone-freezing Yin wind above a thousand zhang, a layer of black ice that makes footing treacherous, and a corrosive gray mist that can dissolve unprotected flesh. Han Li needed special treasures for each.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What happened to the Crying Soul Beast?
cultural_notes_faq.a: By devouring large numbers of Yin-beast souls in the Netherworld Domain, it underwent a unique evolution—gaining the ability to transform into a giant silver ape. This is not a standard Crying Soul Beast mutation; it’s something new.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Han Li stop hunting Yin beasts?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He needs to climb Stormwind Mountain before the next spatial rift opens in about twenty days. If he misses this window, he will have to wait another six months.
